body:
First Ketamine Experience
This is my first trip report so bear with me. I am fairly inexperienced with drugs other than weed which I smoke most days and alcohol which I used to love but I only drink on occasion with friends.
I was alone and rather bored and cut off from my friends by the cruel time between bus pass renewal. So someone I knew in town and asked him if he had an 8th of the very fine imported weed he had. He mentioned he also had a small amount of ketamine which he priced at £10. I bought both and picked up later that day. I planned to take the ketamine with a couple of friends but noting the small amount and my bordom I decided to experiment.
I went with his suggestion and split it into three lines and snorted one directly. It was gentle on the nose though the drip that came later wasnt lovely. I Waited a while smoked a few cigarettes made a pot of tea and lay in bed waiting.
20 mins later I felt a slight buzz, like a measure of gin and a few tokes on a spliff. I could feel little more coming affect so I did another line. 5 mins later I was quite buzzed but I took the last line seeing as it wouldnt have much affect on its own.
The drug came on in a pleasant rush. It was when I tried to move about 15 mins after the last line that I realised I was nicely doped so I put some music on and chilled. Whatever music I put on sounded good (like it does after smoking weed) I longed company and was planning the 200 yard trip to see my friends but a trip to the toilet (10 yards) which took 5 mins of scraping along the wall to keep me upright persuaded me to stay in bed. I kept talking on msn. I was talking general bullshit and realised it but kept going. Every reply I got gave me a burst of joy.
I was vere disattached from my body, and I kept getting the idea that I was viewing the world from other peoples views. When a friend put on his webcam I was transported to their house which was grand. I tried to explain this but it didnt work.
After about 45 mins after last line I trusted my hands enough to roll a spliff
After about 45 mins after last line I trusted my hands enough to roll a spliff
but no way was I gonna smoke it in bed. I imagine it would be easy to set fire or hurt yourself on k and not care or even realise. So I went and sat on a bench. Before sparking the spliff I went to the local shop to buy a drink as the weed is pretty harsh and I jsut had a strange desire to interact with other people in their roles such as shopkeeper. I fell over and got some strange looks. I bought the drink returned to the bench and sparked the spliff. It was this time I noticed the world flashed blue ever few seconds then lapsed into total darkness (no light at all) I later discovered it was blue christmas lights flashing. It was very plesant I smoked the spliff and felt very stoned indeed.
I went back to bed and noticed the girl I was gonna go and see in my bedroom. This was peculiar but welcome. I talked to her or rather at her for a while, then she ceased to exist. This was a bit frustrating. I just lay back and enjoyed the minor alterations in reality I noticed about. Windows media player visuliser was fun for a bit. But I found myself turning with it after a while so stopped looking.
After a couple of hours I was more or less normal again, a bit tired after the weed which is usual and I had a slight headache and was still shaky from the K. Nothing more of note happened that day I continued smoking weed in the form of shottys but the K was not affecting me mentaly anymore and eventually I fell asleep.
Next day I was tired and slightly out of touch with my body (when walking etc). I think the dose I took would have affected a lighter individual a lot more.
I will try K again, In fact as soon as I can get some more but I will do it with a few other people in a nice setting I imagine we will have soem wonderful conversations and come to know each other much better during these experiences. I will also try it in a larger does because although I had a good time I didnt really trip so to speak.
